notes.title: Our Steam page is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195220/658269a9a57b8c483fc38a8d217b8a7fc90f53f0.png[/img]
[h3]Dear Players,[/h3]

I am excited to announce that the Steam page for [b]Rise & Grind[/b] is now live! Get ready for an amazing gaming experience that takes you on a struggle for survival in a whole new world. In this world, you can only awaken once a year due to a curse, but be prepared for thrilling adventures!

[b]Rise & Grind[/b] takes inspiration from games like Forager and others. Wake up, explore, loot, build, expand, defend your region against goblins, sleep, and repeat!

Build your town and increase its population! Construct watchtowers, archer towers, barracks, and station villagers to be prepared for dangers while you sleep for a year!

Craft various tools and equipment using the resources you gather! These items will help you collect more resources and grow!

Engage in trade with merchants who pass through the region from time to time. Buy different resources from them or sell your own!

This world is full of various enemies! Defend your region by defeating attacking enemies like goblins!

"Every awakening is a new adventure, every rebirth is an opportunity to become stronger!"

I will keep you informed with regular updates until the release of [b]Rise & Grind[/b], and we can't wait to provide you with a fun gaming experience once the full version is released. Stay tuned for the release date!

You can visit the [b]Rise & Grind[/b] Steam page to learn more about the game, [b]add it to your wishlist[/b], and follow the updates. We are eagerly looking forward to having you join us on this exciting journey!

Best regards,
[b]AkdumanDev[/b]
